findings.evidence: At c9ef80e the merchant-SKU evidence loop used evidenceById before its declaration: npm run build failed with TS2448/TS2454 and evaluatePurchasability threw ReferenceError for any merchant SKU carrying approvalEvidenceIds. At 981c53f the map is declared at line 683 before the block that uses it at lines 693-697. tsc and build now exit 0. At ee4f5d2 the regression test 'merchant SKU approval evidence is resolved and missing evidence denies' was added to scripts/check-marea-commerce-data.test.mjs: it returns allowed=false without MERCHANT_SKU_APPROVAL_EVIDENCE_INVALID for usable VERIFIED_EXTERNAL evidence, and returns allowed=false with MERCHANT_SKU_APPROVAL_EVIDENCE_INVALID and missingEvidenceIds=['EV-MISSING'] when the evidence id is absent. The 74/74 unit run passes.

findings.evidence: trg_marea_approved_price_immutable covers status, amount_minor, currency, territory, channel, vat_basis, includes_vat, effective_from, approved_by and approved_by_role, and the companion trigger blocks deletion of the approval evidence link. It does not cover edition_id, effective_to or approval_evidence_ids_json. A disposable-DB probe confirms: while the row is APPROVED / 199900, UPDATE edition_id='ed-2', UPDATE effective_to and UPDATE approval_evidence_ids_json='["ev-other"]' all succeed; UPDATE status='REVOKED', UPDATE amount_minor, UPDATE effective_from, UPDATE approved_by and the evidence DELETE abort with MC16_APPROVED_PRICE_IMMUTABLE / MC16_APPROVED_PRICE_EVIDENCE_IMMUTABLE. Latent: 0 approved prices, 0 merchant SKUs, no public or production path.
findings.reproduction: Install MAREA_COMMERCE_SCHEMA_SQL into a temp DB; insert family/edition/gate/evidence/price; link evidence and approve; then UPDATE edition_id, UPDATE effective_to and UPDATE approval_evidence_ids_json while APPROVED: all succeed; UPDATE status, UPDATE amount_minor, UPDATE effective_from, UPDATE approved_by and DELETE evidence abort.
findings.requiredCorrection: Extend the immutable trigger (or add a companion trigger) to cover edition_id, effective_to, approval_evidence_ids_json and any other approval-scoped financial field; keep the status flip, amount and evidence-delete guards.
findings.independentReverification: Re-run the disposable-DB probe after the fix; assert that edition re-binding, expiry mutation and approval-JSON mutation also abort on an APPROVED price.
